page.intro: The assistant helps you get started: existing records on paper, as PDF or in Excel are read in instead of typing everything by hand.
page.step1: Upload a photo, PDF or text, e.g. a judo pass, an attendance list or a training plan.
page.step2: Claude reads the material and makes a proposal.
page.step3: You check the proposal, fill in what is missing and correct differences; uncertain values are marked.
page.step4: Only when you press “Apply” is anything saved, with your normal permissions.
page.safety: The AI cannot change anything itself: it only returns a proposal in a fixed format, sees no member data from Alleda and never picks members. Names are matched here in the browser.
page.notConfigured: The assistant is not set up on this installation yet. An admin has to add an Anthropic API key (see docs/AI_ASSISTANT.md).
